_comment: Runs after mammoth-rig.json. Mammoth's rear deck plate (part 1, the wide cross panel over the back axle) came off the scan chalk white, while the truss it bolts to is copper-brown all the way through. The reference has bare aluminium there, but at game distance the white reads as an untextured hole in the frame rather than as metal, so match it to the truss. No texture is involved — the plate's UVs land on flat atlas, so a plain material is the same fidelity for less.

Parts 20 and 22 are the two diagonal braces that carry the deck up to the spinner mount. Same chalk-white surface, same treatment — the reference has one thin bright steel bar in among them, but these two are broad sheets and reading them as white makes the whole back end look unfinished.

Parts 9 and 11 are the left and right main trusses, and they are NOT uniformly wrong: the arms that run down to the wheels carry the copper texture correctly, and only the flares where they widen out around the spinner mount come off white. So this is boxed by height rather than applied to the whole part — y > -0.17 is the flare, below it is the good arm. Take the cut any higher and a white wedge is left sitting on the deck.
